prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit / pixel-art refinement.
USER LIKES this exact pixel-art character/world direction and says it is finally clear. Their ONLY requested change: "ちょっと荒いからもう少しだけ細やかにして" — a LITTLE more finely resolved, not such coarse pixels.
Edit the reference concept sheet conservatively. Preserve the exact composition, top four-character lineup, bottom school panorama, palette, human-shaped mascots, activities, number/distribution of people and the distinctive sturdy original website feel.
Keep pixel art. Refine the pixel grid ONE modest step: think moving from chunky 24-32px-tall character sprite design toward carefully drawn 40-48px-tall sprite design. Use smaller, cleaner deliberate square pixel clusters with visible stair-step edges, approximately 1.5x to 2x finer logical grid. This is NOT a smooth vector/cartoon remake, not an HD anime redraw. The user liked the blockiness and nostalgic simplicity; preserve that. Do not over-polish or lose the awkward endearing personality.

FOCUSED IMPROVEMENTS:
- Top four mascots: refine head/hair contours with smaller square steps, a few pixels of eyebrows and cheeks, slightly clearer little eyes and expressive mouths. Eyes remain black pixel marks, not giant glossy eyes. Hands become readable small mitten shapes, microphone, note card and yellow flag a little clearer. Smooth neither contours nor fills. Short legs and block shoes remain simple. Preserve all original poses and costume marks: green placket/card, orange headband/flag/white chest stripe, blue side hair buns/yellow sash/microphone, yellow blue headband/white pixel star/orange cape. No additional clothes or accessories. Keep flat warm cream background and four equal visual weights.
- Bottom school scene: keep distant viewpoint and exact spatial structure. Slightly refine pupils' head silhouettes and faces, baton handoff, desks and chairs, note-taking hand, easel flower, watering can and water tap. Building clock and window frames become slightly clearer. Trees remain simple pixel masses with only one restrained shadow shade. Preserve all foreground people and the cozy wide schoolyard. Do not add crowds or zoom in. Preserve one-pixel-outline economy.
- Contour weight: top sprites less heavy black stairsteps with finer clusters, still definite dark outlines. Scene outlines clear and consistent at its smaller scale.
- Keep the dark dividing rule between roster and scene, same landscape 3:2 format. No labels, typography, watermark or UI overlay.

PALETTE: preserve original cream, charcoal, peach, grass green, forest green, brick orange, mustard and school blue. At most a very few discreet flat secondary tones for cheeks/edges, no palette explosion. Broad flat surfaces stay broad and quiet. NO blur, anti-alias haze, brush texture, grain, smooth gradients, glossy highlights, 3D lighting, dithering noise, background mottling or fake CRT scanlines. Every small detail should read as intentionally placed pixels. No animals or franchise characters. Remain recognizable as the exact same artwork, only moderately finer and easier to read.
